newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Two quakes hit Japan, no details_HK observatory.
newsitem.headline: Two quakes hit Japan, no details_HK observatory.

text.p: Two strong earthquakes measured at over 5 on the open-ended Richter scale were detected in Japan on Saturday, Hong Kong's Royal Observatory said.
The epicentre of the first quake at 1.56 a.m Hong Kong time (1756 GMT) was on the main island of Honshu around 90 kms (55 miles) east of the Japanese city of Nagoya.
A second quake at 1.21 p.m. (0521 GMT) was located off the east coast of Honshu some 290 kms (180 miles) southeast of Tokyo, the observatory reported.
It gave no further details on either quake.
